objective: Behavioral cloning of actual human legal face-vector choices. No hand prediction or tactical heuristic reward; not a win-rate optimizer.
initialModel: Verified raw029/v000061013, full12 parameter tensors trainable, fresh AdamW/new optimizer step0
inputs: Same567 encoded own-hand/public state+action features as raw029; no names/rooms/identities/opponent private hands/outcomes as inputs
labels: Only actual human legal action; deduplicate identical54-face action vectors. Exclude test/bot/timeout/assisted=true and forced/auto-finish decisions. Missing assistance flag remains unknown; no assisted override.
data: Existing private snapshot124records/109games/12sessions; fixed guandan-human-v1 whole-match10/1/1 split; exact compiler counts separately saved

optimizer.loss: Mean per-decision cross entropy over distinct legal face vectors; descriptive action tags never enter loss/selection

selection: Lowest validation NLL with fixed minDelta; preserve best matching network/Adam and last checkpoint; evaluate selected and original029 on retrospective test after selection once
acceptance: Report heldout face-vector agreement/NLL and descriptive style. Sample-level imitation improvement requires test NLL lower and agreement higher than raw029; never claim strength or a neural champion; no automatic publication.
limits: Only1validation and1test session; all records were already descriptively inspected; split prevents gradient leakage but is not prospective independent human acceptance
This first batch uses current data only, not future D1 data by default
Output values are imitation logits, not expected upgrade points or calibrated win probabilities
Only native CPU ONNX/GPU parity is checked here; no browser deployment or strength acceptance
